WorkBetterNow () provides full-time positions for professionals in LATAM looking to work with United States-based companies. Our remote professionals come first and are the most important part of our team. If you want to be part of a company that values work-life balance and supports your professional development, you’re in the right place.

Our Core Values
  • Put our Talent first
  • Pursuit of excellence/continuous learning
  • Integrity and transparency
  • Ownership mentality
  • Growth mindset
  • Excellent attitude
The Ideal Candidate
You have advanced English proficiency at a C1 or C2 level and value work-life balance and remote flexibility. You take ownership of your work, communicate with integrity, and bring a great attitude to everything you do. You are genuinely excited about continuous learning and are looking for long-term commitment and stability. Most importantly, you align with our core values and want to grow professionally with a supportive team that truly puts you first.

Job Description

A Business Development Representative (BDR) will be responsible for identifying and developing new business opportunities through proactive outreach and strategic prospecting efforts. This role focuses on expanding the company’s client base by building relationships with decision-makers and qualifying opportunities for the sales team. The ideal candidate is results-driven, organized, and comfortable managing structured outreach initiatives in a remote environment. While your duties will depend on the specific needs of your client, they will include, but not be limited to:
  • Identify target industries, companies, and decision-makers aligned with the company’s growth strategy and ideal customer profile.
  • Execute outbound outreach campaigns through phone calls, email sequences, LinkedIn engagement, and other approved prospecting channels.
  • Qualify prospects by understanding their business challenges, needs, budget, and decisionmaking process.
  • Build and nurture relationships with potential clients through consistent follow-up and
    value-driven communication.
  • Schedule qualified discovery meetings and transfer opportunities to Account Executives with proper documentation and context.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of prospect interactions, pipeline status, and followup actions within CRM systems.
  • Track outreach performance metrics including connection rates, meeting conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.
  • Collaborate with marketing and sales leadership to refine targeting strategies and improve campaign effectiveness.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in business development, outbound sales, or prospecting roles.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience using CRM platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar tools.
  • Ability to meet outreach and pipeline generation targets consistently.
Technical Requirements
  • Processor: Intel 11th Gen (or AMD Ryzen 5000 series) for Windows | M2 for Macs.
  • RAM: 16 GB minimum.
  • Internet: Stable connection of 50 Mbps minimum.
Please note that devices such as MacBook Neos and Chromebooks are not fit for our roles.

Benefits

Compensation & Growth
At WorkBetterNow, we believe in rewarding commitment and supporting long-term success. Our pay structure ensures your compensation evolves with your experience and tenure. Note: The figures below reflect our 2026 ranges; each tenure milestone will increase each year.
  • 0-3 months: $1,200 USD/month
  • After 3 months: You’ll receive a $50 monthly Wellness Bonus to support a healthy and balanced work life (total: $1,250/month).
  • After 1 year: Salary increases to $1,340 USD/month
  • After 2 years: Salary increases to $1,480 USD/month
  • After 3 years: Salary increases to $1,540 USD/month
  • After 4 years: Salary increases to $1,600 USD/month
Two Annual Adjustments: Every year, you benefit from two salary increases: one on your work anniversary, recognizing your continued tenure with WorkBetterNow, and one at the start of each calendar year, when all salary ranges are updated company-wide.

Benefits & Perks
  • 100% remote work — enjoy the comfort and flexibility of working from home
  • 18 paid vacation days + U.S. federal holidays
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave (up to 2 months with 50% salary coverage after 1 year)
  • Client Growth Bonus: Your great work helps our clients scale. For every new hire added to the business you support, you will receive a $50 one-time reward. It’s our way of celebrating the growth you helped make possible.
  • A dedicated Talent Coordinator who serves as your guide and liaison between you, WorkBetterNow, and your assigned company—helping you navigate your role and continue growing professionally.
  • A supportive, people-first environment where your voice matters.

jobs.excerpt: At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members.
jobs.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights – technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

A little bit about our team:

You'll be part of the team behind Warner Music Group's direct-to-consumer storefronts, the online stores where fans buy from some of the world's best-known artists and labels. It's a chance to do meaningful e-commerce work at scale, alongside experienced developers, and to grow your skills on a platform millions of fans rely on.

Your role:

We're looking for a Junior Shopify Developer to help build and improve our Shopify storefronts. You'll join a mature Shopify environment with an established codebase and release process, working on everything from day-to-day fixes to new theme features.

There's a real learning curve here, and we'll support you with structured onboarding and code review. What matters most is solid Shopify fundamentals, clean code habits, and a genuine drive to learn and take on more over time.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Build and customise theme sections, templates and features in Liquid

  • Pick up development tickets, from settings and content changes to bug fixes and new functionality, growing into larger features as you ramp up

  • Build configurable sections with well-structured theme settings, so merchants can make changes without code

  • Write structured, maintainable code: component-based JavaScript, scoped to its section, with clear naming and no one-off workarounds

  • Make sure your work is responsive, cross-browser compatible and accessible

  • Install, configure and troubleshoot Shopify apps

  • Work in Git and pull request workflows, including reviewing and responding to code review

  • Work closely with QA to test and ship changes safely

  • Look for ways to automate repetitive work, using AI tools where they help

About you:

  • 3+ years of hands-on Shopify development experience at an agency or a brand running on Shopify

  • A portfolio of Shopify work you can show us

  • Solid understanding of Shopify themes: sections, templates, theme settings and the Shopify admin

  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, Liquid, JavaScript and TypeScript, plus familiarity with lightweight client-side frameworks such as Stimulus or Alpine.js

  • Understanding of responsive, mobile-first development

  • Working knowledge of accessibility best practices and WCAG 2.1 AA

  • Comfortable with Git and pull requests

  • Experience using AI tools in your development workflow

  • A habit of structured code development: organised files, reusable components and code that other developers can easily read and extend

  • Good problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ownership of your work

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Shopify Plus experience

  • Shopify CLI, Theme Check or the Shopify Admin API (GraphQL)

  • CI/CD experience, for example GitHub Actions

  • Front-end build tooling, such as Vite or webpack

  • Performance optimisation, for example Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.
Love this job and want to apply?
Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

jobs.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. Binance is trusted by more than 320 million people in 100+ countries for its industry-leading security, transparency, trading engine speed, protections for investors, and unmatched portfolio of digital asset products and offerings from trading and finance to education, research, social good, payments, institutional services, and Web3 features. Binance is devoted to building an inclusive crypto ecosystem to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world with crypto as the fundamental means.

About Binance Accelerator Program

Binance Accelerator Program (BAP) is a 3-6 month internship program designed for Early Career talent to have firsthand experience in the rapidly expanding digital assets space. You will be given the opportunity to develop your skills at Binance and understand what it’s like to work at the world's leading blockchain ecosystem. As part of your internship in the BAP, there will also be opportunities for networking and development, which will expand your professional network and build transferable skills to propel you forward in your career. Learn about the BAP Program HERE.

Who may apply

Current university students and recent graduates.
*Terms of employment / engagement shall be subject to contract and local applicable laws
As a Backend Engineer on the Pay & Card team, you will work on backend systems powering crypto and fiat payment experiences for users and merchants globally.You will collaborate with backend engineers, product managers, QA engineers, and other cross-functional teams to build reliable, secure, and scalable payment services. You will gain hands-on experience with high-throughput transaction systems, distributed architectures, payment processing, and financial infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services supporting Binance Pay and Card products.
  • Build scalable APIs and microservices for payment processing, transaction management, merchant services, and related financial workflows.
  • Participate in the development of distributed systems handling high-volume and latency-sensitive transactions.
  • Work with databases, caching systems, message queues, and other infrastructure components to improve system performance and reliability.
  • Implement robust transaction workflows with appropriate handling for retries, idempotency, concurrency, and failure scenarios.
  • Assist with troubleshooting production issues through logs, metrics, tracing, and root-cause analysis.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Contribute to improvements in system reliability, observability, security, and engineering practices.

Requirements

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, and computer science fundamentals.
  • Proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Java, Go, C++, Python, or a similar language.
  • Understanding of relational databases and SQL, including indexes, transactions, and database design fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, HTTP, networking, and client-server architecture.
  • Understanding of operating systems, concurrency, and common backend engineering concepts.
  • Ability to write clear, maintainable code and reason systematically about technical problems.
  • Strong communication skills and willingness to learn in a fast-moving engineering environment.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, or other message-queue technologies.
  • Understanding of distributed-system concepts such as consistency, availability, replication, caching, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance.
  • Knowledge of payment concepts such as authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, chargebacks, and payment lifecycle management.
  • Previous backend engineering internship, personal project, hackathon, or open-source experience.
  • Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, fintech, and payment infrastructure.
Why Binance
• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities include (but are not limited to):

  • Help develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that clearly communicate key metrics and insights across ILEAD’s training and workforce datasets.
  • Help create intuitive data visualizations using Power BI, applying best practices in layout, labeling, and user experience to make complex information easy to understand.
  • Write basic DAX calculations and measures to support reporting requirements and ensure accurate metrics across dashboards.
  • Work from established semantic models and data structures, applying appropriate filtering, relationships, and visual-level transformations.
  • Follow and apply standardized Power BI report templates, visual design conventions, and branding guidelines across all reporting products.
  • Maintain and organize Power BI workspaces, including publishing updates, versioning, documentation, and basic access management.
  • Document dashboards and reports, including purpose, audience, data sources, refresh schedules, and change history.

  • Participate in requirements discussions with stakeholders to capture reporting needs and translate them into clear technical specifications.
  • Conduct quality checks and basic validation on data visualizations to ensure accuracy, completeness, and alignment with defined requirements.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including testing visual elements, logging defects, and verifying resolutions.

  • Bachelor's degree in data analytics, information systems, computer science, or a related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience working with Power BI, including dashboard development and basic data modeling concepts.
  • Foundational knowledge of DAX and Power Query.
  • Understanding of data visualization best practices and effective communication of analytical findings.
  • Ability to learn and apply federal data governance, reporting standards, and accessibility requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality analytical outputs.

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience working with Microsoft SQL Server or semantic data models.
  • Familiarity with Section 508/WCAG accessibility guidelines.
  • Experience supporting user testing, quality assurance, or iterative dashboard updates.
  • Exposure to large datasets or enterprise reporting environments.
  • Familiarity with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem including Teams, SharePoint, and Power Platform

At SafeLease, we're rethinking how P&C insurance is sold in an age of technological change. We believe the industry's biggest inefficiencies aren't technical problems — they're structural ones. And we're building the team to tackle them.

Most insurance companies either distribute products or bear the risk — we do both. We back our policies with our own capital, which means we control the full stack: product design, tech, and the speed at which we move. That end-to-end ownership lets us offer customers real flexibility, saving time and money for more than 4,000 properties insured for billions in value nationwide.

We're a team of 85, growing over 100% annually, and we've done it without sacrificing profitability or culture. Here, you'll get high discretion and a wide aperture of problems to solve. We embrace the newest technologies, move fast together, and operate with the intensity of a small company where every person's work is visible. If you're looking for a place to sharpen your craft alongside people who take their work seriously, you'll fit right in.
